title: Ember Dragon statement wall
story: A Wicker Park apartment wanted one bold piece to anchor a bare hallway wall. We printed the Ember Dragon artwork, a high-detail cinematic dragon, at 45 by 90 cm on a matte stock that keeps the fine scale-work sharp up close, which is exactly how people see it in a narrow hallway. Proof that a custom wall print does not have to be a cityscape to feel like it belongs in the space.

photos.alt: High-detail cinematic dragon wall print installed as a statement piece on an interior hallway wall
